The `ic_service_*.xml` vectors are adapted from [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/1089fb7d2bf0e323f834c205ab76265005a6d5e8/icons), revision `1089fb7d2bf0e323f834c205ab76265005a6d5e8`, under [CC0 1.0](LICENSE.md).

The SVG path data is preserved; Android vector resources apply the corresponding brand colors. Installed app icons are used when available, with these bundled vectors as the fallback.

The Amazon Music icon is from revision [`abacde1e57bf3ca327de130b5d943562c12ad424`](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/abacde1e57bf3ca327de130b5d943562c12ad424/icons/amazonmusic.svg).
